claims.text: Known or suspected exposure to contaminated food: observe carefully; activated charcoal or purgatives may help
claims.quote: Anyone known or thought to have been exposed to contaminated food must be carefully observed. Administration of activated charcoal or purgatives may be helpful.

claims.text: Significant Sx: charcoal via gastric tube, w the airway protected by a cuffed endotracheal tube (impaired airway reflexes)
claims.quote: Patients with significant symptoms often have impaired airway reflexes, so charcoal, if used, should be given via gastric tube, and the airway should be protected by a cuffed endotracheal tube.
